meta.name: Criminal Justice
meta.description: Sex, drugs and a gruesome murder. An edgy one night stand turns into a nightmare for Aditya, when he wakes up with blood on his hands. The evidence is stacked against him, but he doesn't remember the grisly crime. Is he guilty or not ?

videos.title: Once Upon a Night
videos.overview: Driving his family's cab for one night, Aditya picks up a young woman, Sanaya, and ends up spending the evening with her. After a night of sex and drugs, he wakes up to find her stabbed to death but has no recollection of what happened.

videos.title: Under Arrest
videos.overview: By the end of the night, Aditya is in police custody. Madhav, a small-time advocate bargains to represent him, but fails. To his surprise, Mandira, a big fish in the game takes up Aditya's case pro bono.

videos.title: The Price of Life
videos.overview: Mandira grapples with Aditya's amnesia related to the fateful night, whereas, Madhav finds a new lead in his investigation. Meanwhile, in jail, Mustafa makes an unexpected demand from Aditya.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Mustafa takes Aditya under his wing and gives him an unusual welcome gift. At the trial, Madhav realises that a mountain of evidence is stacked against Aditya.

videos.title: Beginning of the End
videos.overview: The tension between Mustafa and Layak heats up. Meanwhile, Aditya weighs the pros and cons of pleading guilty as Jimmy D'Souza makes a shocking revelation in court.

videos.title: Judgement Day
videos.overview: While Aditya takes on a daunting task to appease Mustafa, Nikhat risks her career to free him. Will she prove his innocence?

videos.title: A New Bond
videos.overview: Aditya’s bond with Mustafa deepens but his family begins to crumble. Meanwhile, Madhav finds a dangerous lead, giving the case a new direction.

videos.title: The Going Gets Tough
videos.overview: With the entry of a new rival, Aditya and Mustafa end up in solitary confinement. Meanwhile, Madhav and Nikhat find a previously unnoticed clue.

videos.title: A New Kingpin
videos.overview: A brutal fight sends Aditya to the hospital, where he meets Mustafa. Raghu helps Madhav and Nikhat, and together they open a new can of worms.

videos.title: The Mystery
videos.overview: Aditya peddles drugs in jail, but that doesn't go well with Layak. Raghu produces a search warrant against the new suspect. Pushed into a corner, Aditya plans his final revenge.
